definition: גֹּ֫מֶא noun masculine Job 8:11 rush, reed, papyrus (compare Löw p. 55 ) (Late Hebrew גּוֺמֶא , Ethiopic loan-word, according to Di ; — name from swallowing , sucking up, water? so Thes , compare Che Isa 18:2 and elsewhere; = Coptic gome , see Di Exod 2:3 whence others derive as loan-word) — גֹּ֫מֶא Exod 2:3 + 3 t.; — rush, paper-reed , (Egyptian) Job 8:11 (|| אָחוּ ); collective Isa 35:7 (|| קָנֶה ); as material, ׳ תֵּבַת ג Exod 2:3 chest of paper-reed ; ׳ כְּלֵיגֿ Isa 18:2 vessels of paper-reed.
